t: A rugged Raspberry Pi gateway that talks to building and factory gear.
steps: Buy it from Seeed Studio or a distributor such as DigiKey.
Wire a 12 to 24 V power supply to the green terminal block.
Plug in a network cable and find the gateway on your network.
Log in over SSH with the default details from the Seeed wiki.
Follow the Seeed guide to install Node-RED.
Try the RS485 and Modbus RTU guide with one sensor.
Add a dashboard such as ThingsBoard to show your readings.
meta: Open Board. From $209. A few stores.
